columns_never_fillable.evidence: Per-property NPI is NOT disclosed anywhere in the AR. Anchor pages checked: (a) Note 26 OPERATING SEGMENTS pp.105-106 discloses Gross revenue and Net property income only for TWO reportable segments - 'Hospitals and Medical Centres' (GR 101,864 / NPI 98,011) and 'Nursing Homes' (GR 43,404 / NPI 38,586), totalling 145,268 / 136,597 - never by property; (b) Note 26 geographical information p.106 splits only Revenue (not NPI) by country (SG 101,583; Japan 43,032; France 372; Malaysia 281); (c) Note 15 GROSS REVENUE p.92 and Note 16 PROPERTY EXPENSES p.92 are Group/Trust totals only; (d) Portfolio Statement pp.128-143 has no income columns (only tenure, lease term, location, use, valuation, % of net assets); (e) Our Portfolio property cards pp.21-31 disclose Gross Revenue + Committed Occupancy but NO property-level NPI or property expenses; (f) Financial Review p.20 gives group NPI S$136.6m only. NPI cannot be computed per property because property expenses (Note 16, $8,671k) are not broken out per property. Genuinely absent.

No per-property share of portfolio NPI is disclosed. The only per-property percentage in the AR is 'Percentage of net assets' in the Portfolio Statement pp.128-143, which is a VALUATION weight (market value / net assets), not an NPI contribution. Note 26 p.106 gives a geographical Revenue split but no per-property or per-geography NPI percentage. Genuinely absent.

Lettable area (GLA/NLA) is not disclosed. Property cards pp.21-31 and Portfolio Statement pp.128-143 disclose only 'Floor Area (sq m)' (captured as gfa) and, for Japan/France, 'Land Area (sq m)' (not a schema field). SG footnote p.20 confirms the area figure is gross floor area / strata area owned, not lettable area. Genuinely absent.

The Portfolio Statement 'Tenure of land / Term of lease (years) / Remaining term of lease (years)' columns pp.128-143 show 'N.A.' for all 60 Japan (except Orange no Sato), all 11 France, and the 1 Malaysia property - they are Freehold, so there is no land-lease term/expiry to disclose. Values correctly left null for these 71 rows; the 4 Leasehold rows are filled.

Cards list lessee/operator names but do not disclose per-property tenant revenue percentages. The p.19 'Top 10 tenants by % of gross revenue' table is REIT-level (e.g. Parkway Hospitals 59.2%), not per-property. Genuinely absent.
